about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: My journey combines technology, sports, creativity, and family-business experience.
about.storyTitle: Experience, responsibility, and curiosity for technology.
about.story1: I attended schools in Bishkek and Osh and learned to adapt to new environments and people. My interests include technology, sports, and creative projects.
about.story2: From an early age I helped my father run our family café, from cooking and stock handling to expenses and daily operations. That experience taught me responsibility and independence. Our family now has a shop called Madina Shop.
about.story3: After grade 10, I completed three months of Frontend training at Okurmen. I build React and TypeScript projects. I practiced freestyle wrestling for two years, took part in Kyrgyz language, mathematics and chemistry olympiads, and joined creative and international events.
about.quote: My goal is not only to write code, but to create products that are clear and useful to people.

el-bem-beauty.title: EL BEM BEAUTY
el-bem-beauty.summary: Beauty salon website with services, specialists, booking, shop, cart, and admin interfaces.
el-bem-beauty.detail: An exam-oriented learning project for a beauty salon. I worked on services and specialist catalogs, booking time selection, cart, admin pages, multilingual support, and mobile responsiveness. I practiced Firebase integration and Vercel deployment.

nurikbrand.title: NURIKBRAND
nurikbrand.summary: A personal e-commerce concept with product listings, a cart, and management interfaces.
nurikbrand.detail: An online store prototype covering product pages, categories, cart behavior, checkout flow, and an admin interface layout.

abu-mobile.title: Abu Mobile
abu-mobile.summary: Phone and accessories store UI with a catalog and content management features.
abu-mobile.detail: A personal learning project for an electronics shop, focused on product catalog, cards, purchase flow, and basic content management interfaces.

madina-uzgen.title: Madina Uzgen
madina-uzgen.summary: A clothing, cosmetics, and womenswear shop with administrative interfaces.
madina-uzgen.detail: A personal e-commerce project focused on clothing, cosmetics, and accessories, including storefront structure, navigation, product pages, and management interfaces.

konok-kg.title: KONOK KG
konok-kg.summary: A tourism platform concept featuring seven regions of Kyrgyzstan and excursions.
konok-kg.detail: A learning concept for discovering Kyrgyzstan: seven regions, attractions, local history, excursions, products, and multilingual navigation. It is a concept, not a claim of a fully deployed service.
